world.title: US eases Russia sanctions bill, cuts tariff threat on India and China from 500% to 100%
world.summary: US senators introduced a revised Russia sanctions bill aimed at pressuring Moscow and its significant energy buyers, including India and China. The updated legislation reduces the proposed tariff threat on these countries from 500% to 100%. The changes reflect a strategic adjustment in the US approach to sanctions while maintaining pressure on Russia's energy sector.

world.title: Trump backs bill that could hit India with 500% tariffs over Russian oil trade
world.summary: Donald Trump has endorsed a US sanctions bill that may impose tariffs of up to 500% on countries purchasing Russian oil, potentially affecting India and China. During a discussion on the matter, Trump stated, "We have to look. That hasn't been discussed yet." This development could strain India's trade relations with the United States amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

world.title: US, Russian astronauts launch into orbit for joint space mission
world.summary: A joint US-Russian space mission launched from Kazakhstan to the International Space Station (ISS), emphasizing collaboration amid geopolitical tensions. NASA chief Jared Isaacman attended the launch at the Baikonur Cosmodrome, marking a significant moment in space cooperation. The Soyuz MS-29 spacecraft carries Russian astronauts and a NASA astronaut, showcasing continued partnership despite ongoing conflicts between the nations.

business.title: Based On Tekton Launching Soon
business.summary: Nissan is set to launch a new 7-seater vehicle based on the Tekton in the Indian market. The company has experienced significant ups and downs, with past successes including the Micra, Sunny, and Terrano, contrasted by the unsuccessful Datsun initiative. This upcoming model aims to revitalize Nissan's presence in India, moving forward from previous challenges.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Kusumgar, IOL Chemicals, Delhivery, L&T Technology in focus on 15 July
business.summary: On July 15, 2026, several stocks will be in focus, including L&T Technology Services, Tata Elxsi, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Easy Trip Planners, and IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals. Investors are encouraged to monitor these companies for potential significant developments, including investments, deals, quarterly earnings, and acquisitions.

technology.title: Spotify brings chatbot-powered music discovery
technology.summary: Spotify has introduced a new feature called "Talk to Spotify," allowing Premium subscribers to discover music through conversational interactions. This beta feature utilizes artificial intelligence to enhance user experience, enabling natural dialogue with the streaming service. The initiative aims to improve music discovery, making it more intuitive and personalized for users seeking new tracks and artists.

technology.title: PlayStation's Social Feeds Are Still on Fire
technology.summary: Sony's decision to discontinue physical disc production for PlayStation has sparked significant backlash on social media, continuing weeks after the announcement. Developers utilizing PlayStation's promotional channels are overwhelmed by negative comments regarding Blu-ray discs. Analysts suggest that the company's digital profits make a reversal of this decision unlikely, indicating a shift towards a fully digital gaming future.

technology.title: PlayStation's FlexStrike Wireless Fight Stick Postponed Due to "Unexpected Production Delays"
technology.summary: PlayStation has delayed the launch of its FlexStrike wireless fight stick due to unforeseen production issues. The announcement was made on July 14, 2026, through an official blog post. The new release date has not yet been determined. The company cited unexpected production delays as the reason for the postponement, impacting the anticipated availability of the product.

sports.title: France vs Spain, FIFA World Cup semifinal LIVE: Porro scores as Spain goes 2-0 up
sports.summary: Spain is currently leading France 2-0 in the FIFA World Cup semifinal at AT&T Stadium in Arlington on July 14, 2026. Porro scored one of the goals for Spain. France made changes to their lineup, recalling Bradley Barcola in attack and Aurelien Tchouameni in midfield. The match continues with live coverage available from various sources.

sports.title: Tottenham demand €50m for Romero, too expensive for Inter
sports.summary: Tottenham Hotspur are asking for €50 million to sell defender Cristian Romero, according to Sportitalia. This high price tag makes it unlikely that Inter Milan will secure his transfer, as they face competition from Barcelona. The situation was further reported by Fabrizio Romano on his YouTube channel, highlighting the challenges Inter faces in acquiring the player.

sports.title: Shubman Gill's 80, Axar-Washington stand give India 1-0 lead over England in ODI series
sports.summary: Shubman Gill scored 80 runs as India secured a six-wicket victory over England in the first ODI at Edgbaston on Tuesday. This win gives India a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Gill's performance continued his strong record at the venue, contributing significantly to India's successful chase in the match against England.

health.title: IMA issues diectives on Chandipura virus in Gujarat
health.summary: The Gujarat State Branch of the Indian Medical Association (GSB-IMA) has issued an advisory regarding the Chandipura virus, urging pediatricians to assess children's medical history and symptoms, including high fever and convulsions, following three reported deaths. The organization emphasized the importance of strict preventive measures to curb the spread of this dangerous sandfly-borne virus in the region.

health.title: 3 children dead, 4 on life support as Chandipura virus outbreak hits Gujarat
health.summary: Gujarat has reported 32 suspected cases of the Chandipura virus since July 1, with seven confirmed infections among children. The outbreak has resulted in the deaths of three children, while four others remain on life support. In response, the health department has heightened surveillance, treatment efforts, and sandfly-control measures to manage the situation effectively.

health.title: FDA's Traceback Endeavor: Tackling Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
health.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is investigating multiple produce items to trace the source of a cyclosporiasis outbreak. This intestinal infection is typically contracted through contaminated raw fruits and vegetables. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention highlights the risks associated with consuming such contaminated produce, prompting the FDA's efforts to ensure food safety.

science.title: Scientists use sound waves to create protective crystal coatings on crops
science.summary: Researchers at RMIT University have developed a novel method using high-frequency sound waves to apply protective crystal coatings on plant leaves. This innovative technique creates a fine mist that forms crystal layers, enhancing crop protection without harming the plants. The system aims to improve agricultural practices by providing a safe and effective way to shield crops from environmental threats.

science.title: Earliest galaxies were well organised less than a billion years after Big Bang, reveals IUCAA study
science.summary: A study by IUCAA utilizing the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has discovered spheroidal galaxies formed 400–900 million years after the Big Bang. These galaxies exhibit the Kormendy relation, indicating a level of organization previously thought to develop later in cosmic history. This finding suggests that early galaxies were more structured than previously understood.

science.title: A new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures
science.summary: Researchers have developed a new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures. This innovative method is expected to facilitate the creation of next-generation devices, which could significantly advance research in quantum computing. The technique aims to improve the quality and performance of materials used in various applications, potentially impacting the future of technological development.

entertainment.title: Aamir Khan faces fatwa after marrying Gauri Spratt; cleric objects to interfaith marriage: 'Gair Muslim se shaadi karna haraam hai'
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan is facing backlash after marrying Gauri Spratt, with a Muslim cleric objecting to their interfaith union. The cleric declared the marriage impermissible under his interpretation of Islamic law, stating that marrying a non-Muslim is forbidden. This controversy arises shortly after the couple's wedding, drawing attention to issues surrounding interfaith relationships within the Muslim community.

entertainment.title: Ayodhya priest's remark sparks uproar
entertainment.summary: A religious leader has offered a Rs 5 crore reward for the killing of actor Aamir Khan, amid escalating backlash over his marriage to Gauri Spratt. The situation has intensified with protests, effigy burnings, and allegations of “love jihad” from members of the Bajrang Dal. Khan's personal life has become a focal point for ongoing controversy and threats.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope predictions for July 15, 2026, provide insights into astrological events affecting all 12 zodiac signs. The analysis includes the movements of planets and their alignments, offering guidance on how these celestial influences may impact individuals. Readers can explore personalized forecasts to understand potential challenges and opportunities based on their zodiac sign for the day ahead.
